INSIDE LEDGERLY

Spend that explains itself.

Ledgerly sits between your company cards and your ledger, keeping the middle of the work clean.

01
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction is categorised the moment it lands, using rules you control. Your team reviews the exceptions, not the whole ledger.

02
Duplicate detection

Matching charges are paired before they reach the books. See both sides, keep the right one, and move on.

03
Month-end close

Reconcile, approve, and export from a single clean view. Close on time without chasing people for receipts.

HOW IT WORKS

A close in three steps.

Set up once, then review only what needs a decision. Ledgerly keeps the rest moving.
